steps.name: 01-claws-at-full-power.png
steps.scene: PAGE 1: sleeves rolled up, the machine still will not budge. CAMERA at WAIST HEIGHT, STRICT SIDE view. Girl at LEFT faces RIGHT toward ONE large stationary stamping press, full body from head to boots visible with generous space above/below. A rigid horizontal INPUT SHAFT sticks LEFT out of the press at about her forehead height. She hangs quietly by BOTH HUMAN HANDS gripping the SAME solid shaft close together, wrists above her face, arms extending naturally upward from two shoulders, relaxed elbows. Her body hangs below the hands, skirt over long tights-clad legs, knees slightly bent, boots hanging just a SMALL distance above floor. Make mechanical geometry physically plausible: fixed shaft attached to press, both hands wrap the shaft, torso directly below arms, no impossible levitation or dislocated arms. Natural SIX-head adult silhouette, relatively SMALL head. Sleepy resigned profile, cheeks slightly puffed, eyes on shaft, not camera. Pale gray jacket sleeves pushed back enough to see wrists. Press a broad simple block occupying RIGHT half with one unmoving ram, ONE rough ingot on its bed, and one large round gauge needle resting at its leftmost end (no digits). Bare cool wall, one warm overhead light, broad blank floor. No other machines, no clutter, no flying scrap or impact effects. Quiet cute failed exertion.
